name: Mia Clementis
original_name: ミア・クレメンティス
source:
Mia is [url=/c1356]Feena[/url]'s only escort from the Kingdom of Sphere and always tries to look out for the princess. Daughter of Feena's nursing mother, works as Feena's maid. Greatly respects Feena. Has taken up part of the daily work in the Asagiri house. 

[Edited from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=152981&gc=gc]Getchu[/url].]
